mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration and imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increase >0.5pp MoM is followed by positive 5-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for UNRATE < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS growth >0.5% MoM fails to yield positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 signals acute supply chain disruption, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate margins compress and recession risks rise.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 90.0 is followed by positive 60-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal strengthening consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: HOUST growth >0.3% MoM fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC for HOUST < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% is followed by positive 20-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth exceeding 0.3% MoM and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2% MoM signals a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through elevated wage growth and consumer spending.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS growth >0.3% MoM and UNRATE decline >0.2% MoM fails to yield positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year GDP growth exceeding 2.0% signals late-cycle economic expansion where equity valuations become stretched, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to profit-taking and rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0% is followed by positive 60-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for GDPC1 growth < 0.02.
